theme.en: Less repeat work across the asset workflow
theme.zh: 减少资产制作与协作中的重复工作

subject.en: Less repeat work for your next game-asset batch
subject.zh: 下一批游戏资产，减少重复制作与交接

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

If %COMPANYNAME% is growing its game-asset library, starting every character or prop from scratch can take artists away from the next milestone.

Tripo Studio Team Plan brings 3D generation and shared assets into one workspace:
• Generate starting models from text or images for artists to refine.
• Find and reuse team assets without another file request.
• Manage shared credits and member access in one place.

Your artists stay in control of refinement and approval.

Could this reduce the work behind your next asset batch? Leave your details to discuss Team Plan with Tripo, or see the workflow first.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，你好，

如果 %COMPANYNAME% 的游戏资产需求正在增长，每个角色或道具都从头制作，就可能挤占美术为下一阶段交付投入的时间。

Tripo Studio 团队版将3D生成与共享资产放进同一个工作区：
• 从文字或图片生成初始模型，交给美术继续精修。
• 找到并复用团队资产，不必反复索取文件。
• 在一处管理共享积分与成员权限。

精修与最终验收仍由你的美术团队掌控。

这能否减少下一批资产的制作与协作投入？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通团队方案，也可以先了解具体流程。

followup.en:
The workflow starts with a concept or reference image. Generate a starting model in the team workspace, refine it for the project, and organize shared assets for reuse. Asset visibility follows your team's permissions; external edits must be managed in your own workflow.

To assess the business fit, choose 10 planned characters or props. Compare total artist hours, finishing effort, handoffs and accepted assets with your current process.

Leave your details to discuss the scope, access and responsibilities with Tripo before starting.
followup.zh:
从概念或参考图出发，在团队工作区生成初始模型，再围绕项目精修，并整理可共享、可复用的资产。资产可见范围遵循团队权限；外部工具中的修改仍需在现有流程中管理。

评估是否适合业务时，可以选择10项计划制作的角色或道具，对照现有流程，比较美术总工时、精修投入、交接次数和通过验收的资产数量。

留下联系方式，开始前与 Tripo 沟通范围、使用安排和执行分工。

theme.en: Build the assets your next playable version needs
theme.zh: 为下一次可玩版本准备项目资产

subject.en: From asset requests to your next playable build
subject.zh: 从资产需求，到下一次可玩版本

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

If %COMPANYNAME% is preparing its next playable build, your artists need a practical route from concept art to the characters and props that project needs.

Tripo Studio Team Plan supports that work in a shared workspace:
• Turn text or reference images into starting 3D models.
• Keep project assets accessible for teammates to find and reuse.
• Coordinate shared credits and member access as the team works.

Artists refine the models and check them in your target engine.

Want to explore where it fits your next build? See a real prop workflow, or leave your details to discuss your project with Tripo.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，你好，

如果 %COMPANYNAME% 正在准备下一个可玩版本，美术团队需要一条可执行的路径，把概念设计推进为项目所需的角色与道具。

Tripo Studio 团队版在共享工作区里支持这项工作：
• 从文字或参考图生成初始3D模型。
• 集中整理项目资产，让成员查找和复用。
• 在制作过程中统一管理共享积分与成员权限。

美术继续精修模型，并在目标引擎中完成检查。

想了解它能用于下一次游戏构建的哪些环节？可以先看真实道具制作流程，或留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通项目需求。

followup.en:
Tripo's treasure-chest walkthrough shows a generated base developed into material variations and an opening interaction, with artist refinement along the way.

For your own build, identify 10 planned assets and agree on art, geometry and engine checks. Compare accepted assets, finishing effort and reuse with your current process.

The example illustrates a Studio production workflow, not a measured Team Plan cost saving. Leave your details to discuss your project's scope and access with Tripo.
followup.zh:
Tripo 的宝箱制作示例展示了：基于生成模型，经美术继续制作，发展出材质变体与开箱交互。

针对自己的游戏版本，可以选择10项计划制作的资产，先约定美术、几何和引擎检查标准，再与现有流程比较通过验收的资产、后续制作投入和复用情况。

该示例展示 Studio 制作流程，不代表团队版已实现的降本比例。留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通项目范围及使用安排。

theme.en: Add generation to your workflow without building the model stack
theme.zh: 把生成接入资产流程，不必自研底层模型

subject.en: Add 3D generation to the tools your team uses
subject.zh: 把3D生成接入团队正在使用的工具

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

If %COMPANYNAME% is adding 3D generation to its game tools, an existing API lets your engineers focus on the tool instead of developing the underlying generation model.

Tripo API makes generation a programmable step in your asset workflow:
• Generate starting models from text or images.
• Submit tasks and track their progress from your own tool.
• Retrieve outputs for artist refinement and project checks.

Your team controls the integration and user experience.

Want to assess the integration effort and total cost? Leave your details to discuss your workflow with Tripo, or explore the request-to-result process first.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，你好，

如果 %COMPANYNAME% 希望在游戏工具里加入3D生成，接入现成 API，可以让工程投入聚焦自己的工具，而不必从头开发底层生成模型。

Tripo API 将生成变成资产流程中可通过程序调用的一环：
• 从文字或图片生成初始模型。
• 在自己的工具里提交任务并跟踪进度。
• 取回输出，交给美术精修和项目验收。

系统接入与用户体验仍由你的团队掌控。

想评估接入工作量和完整成本？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通现有流程，也可以先了解从请求到取回结果的具体步骤。

followup.en:
Your tool creates a generation task, checks its status and retrieves the model when the task succeeds. Your team connects those steps to its own review and production tools.

For an initial benchmark, select 10 real game assets. Track integration time, generation and retry fees, artist cleanup, engine checks and accepted assets. Include ongoing maintenance when comparing total cost.

Tripo provides the generation layer. Your team runs the benchmark unless a different arrangement is agreed. Leave your details to discuss the scope and access.
followup.zh:
工具创建生成任务、查询状态，并在任务成功后取回模型。你的团队将这些步骤接入自己的审核与制作工具。

首次基准测试可以选择10项真实游戏资产，记录接入工时、生成与重试费用、美术清理、引擎检查及验收通过的资产。比较总成本时，也计入后续维护投入。

Tripo 提供生成层；除非另有约定，基准测试由你的团队执行。留下联系方式，沟通范围和使用安排。

theme.en: Bring 3D product content into your platform
theme.zh: 为内容平台接入3D产品展示能力

subject.en: A route from product images to 3D showcases
subject.zh: 从产品图片，到3D产品展示

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

If %COMPANYNAME% wants to offer 3D product showcases, existing product images can be a starting point without developing a generation model in-house.

Tripo API provides the generation step for your content platform:
• Turn product images into starting 3D models.
• Submit tasks, track progress and retrieve results programmatically.
• Pass the models into your own review and publishing workflow.

Your team checks product details, refines the outputs and builds the viewing experience.

Want to assess the fit and full implementation cost? Leave your details to discuss your product-content needs with Tripo, or explore the workflow first.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，你好，

如果 %COMPANYNAME% 希望提供3D产品展示，可以从已有产品图片出发，而不必从头自研生成模型。

Tripo API 为内容平台提供模型生成这一环：
• 将产品图片转为初始3D模型。
• 通过程序提交任务、跟踪进度并取回结果。
• 把模型交给自己平台的审核与发布流程。

你的团队检查产品细节、修正输出，并开发展示体验。

想评估它是否适配，以及完整实施成本？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通产品内容需求，也可以先了解具体流程。

followup.en:
Your platform sends a product image, tracks the generation task and retrieves the model for review. Your team checks shape, materials and important product details before adding it to the viewing experience.

Start an evaluation with 10 real products. Record accepted assets, correction work, generation and retry fees, integration, viewer development and maintenance.

This compares the full content workflow, not just generation speed. Leave your details to discuss scope and access with Tripo; your team runs the evaluation unless agreed otherwise.
followup.zh:
平台发送产品图片、跟踪生成任务，并取回模型供审核。你的团队先检查外形、材质和关键产品细节，再将其接入展示体验。

可以用10款真实产品开始评估，记录通过验收的资产、人工修正、生成与重试费用，以及系统接入、查看器开发和维护投入。

比较的是完整内容流程，不只是生成速度。留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通范围及使用安排；除非另有约定，评估由你的团队执行。
